planning.scope: Kaksi pohjaa ja kolme kuviota: kuusi eri paria, mikä tahansa lisäysjärjestys, poisto ja kohdennettu pyydetty hakuvihje. Siirtotehtävä rakentaa kaikki neljän nimetyn rastin6 järjestyksetöntä yhteyttä. Kertolaskua ei vaadita; ei numeropuu- tai kolmannen valintajoukon pakkoa.
planning.evidenceLimits: Täydellinen lopputulos ei yksin osoita käytettyä hakustrategiaa. Annettu matemaattinen joukko tarkistetaan, ei prosessiroolin yleistä hallintaa tai siirtovaikutusta. No persistence, mastery awards, efficacy claim or human validation.
planning.curriculumVsDesign: Frozen canonical band/roles/groups/relations retained. Foreign educational guidance corroborates design; it is not new Finnish OPS evidence. Story, numerical bounds, original diagrams, manual steps and constructive checks are project design.

planning.interactionType: Choose one option from each category and add the pair to a visible record in the learner’s chosen order; remove/repair, optional organise, final set check. Transfer: select two pictured stations to add a link and check missing/duplicate/self connections.
planning.support: Optional organise-by-first-choice, row model and adult practical card search; help is scaffolding, no evidence credit.
planning.offline: Paper-card pairing, record every design; compare two complete lists with different orders. Trail-connection transfer can use four picture cards and strings, no real handshaking required.
planning.advanced: Add a third emblem/background or introduce one forbidden combination; explain why simple multiplication needs a complete independent choice set.
planning.exitQuestion: Miten voit näyttää, ettei yhtään vaihtoehtoa puutu?
planning.accessibility: Native buttons >=48px target in scoped CSS; explicit aria labels and pressed states, visible chosen targets, polite feedback; no drag, mandatory audio, speech check, object-name production or timed response. Manual model steps; root controls disable while paused.
planning.reviewStatus: Revised after independent Hume P2 finding; author targeted regression checks passed. Targeted independent rereview, main integration and human testing remain separate.

targetedCorrection.change: Both record checkers first require an array with at most six entries, every numeric index an own populated canonical string. Holes, undefined, extra slots, nonarrays, unsupported/prototype-name values and inherited-only entries cannot pass.
